fields.title: 📖 Validity of the prayer versus judgment about persons
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿUmar, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī and Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“Pray behind him – and his bidʿah rests upon him.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The question of prayer behind an imām is fiqh: imāmah, avoidance, repetition and the jamāʿah. It is not an automatic takfīr of the one who prays.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Abī Shaybah, al-Muṣannaf, Kitāb al-Ḥajj; Ibn al-Mundhir, al-Awsaṭ; Ibn Qudāmah, al-Mughnī; Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā.
immutable.scholar: Ibn ʿUmar, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī und Ibn Taymiyyah
